issues.root_cause_found: The oil-filter-wrench category (published 10-05) shipped with 3 FABRICATED products: 'ARES 17-Piece Cap Set' (ARES makes no oil filter cap wrench; 70030 does not exist), 'Astro 6070 Adjustable Pliers' (Astro Pneumatic makes no oil filter pliers), 'ABN Universal 3-Jaw' (no ABN-branded 3-jaw on Amazon). issues.lesson: Content-generated 'brand+model' product names MUST be verified against a real Amazon listing before publish. A plausible-sounding brand+model number is not evidence the product exists.
